project.name: settings
project.description: The settings catalog (com.agenticai.core.settings): the behaviour settings a tenant admin or an agent editor may change, each declared once with type, unit, bounds, risk, scopes and the platform property it defaults from. Overrides are scoped (tenant, agent), versioned and kept in an immutable history; SettingsResolver is the single lookup every use site calls (agent over tenant over platform over default, fail-safe to the platform value). Depends on security (TenantContext) and audit (AuditLogService) only, so any module can depend on it without a cycle. Modules contribute their entries as SettingsContributor beans. See docs/settings.md.
